Turnstiles and Secured Entrances for Lobbies, Plants and Campuses

A card reader controls a door. An entrance lane controls the person. Stop tailgating without slowing down the people who belong there.

One Credential, One Person

Stop Tailgating at the Front Door

An open door lets in whoever is behind the badge holder. Optical turnstiles and security entrances count each person, sound an alarm on tailgating, and send the video clip to whoever needs to see it.

We handle the parts most turnstile projects get wrong: the reader integration, fire alarm release, ADA lanes, and the concrete and power the lanes need before they arrive.

  1. 01Badge or phone at the lane reader
  2. 02Lane opens for exactly one person
  3. 03A second person triggers an alarm and a video clip
Entrance Types

Matched to Your Traffic and Your Risk

Optical Speed Lanes

Glass-wing lanes that open for authorized users and alarm on tailgating.

Best for: corporate and medical office lobbies

Waist-High Tripod Turnstiles

Durable, economical one-at-a-time entry for high-volume staff areas.

Best for: fitness and recreation centers, staff entries

Full-Height Turnstiles

Floor-to-head rotors for unattended perimeter gates. Nobody climbs over.

Best for: plant perimeters, yards and utilities

Security Revolving Doors

One person per rotation, with sensors that detect a second occupant.

Best for: data rooms and high-security buildings

Interlock Vestibules

Two doors that never open at the same time, controlled by the access system.

Best for: pharmacies, cash rooms and labs

Accessible Swing Gates

Wide lanes for wheelchairs, deliveries and strollers, on the same credential.

Best for: every lane bank, per ADA
